# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

This is a single-page guide from thechelsuk (https://thechels.uk) for people joining the TheChels team on BOINC, the Berkeley Open Infrastructure for Network Computing.

Key facts:

- BOINC lets volunteers donate spare computer time to university research projects
- The guide covers Rosetta@home (protein folding for disease research) and World Community Grid (an umbrella project for health and climate research)
- Tasks run at low priority, so normal computer use isn't slowed down
- Suggested minimum memory: 1 GB RAM for a single-core machine, 2 GB for dual-core and 4 GB for quad-core

## Guide

- [How to join the TheChels BOINC team]({{ "/" | absolute_url }}): installing BOINC, attaching to Rosetta@home, adjusting account settings, joining the TheChels team and troubleshooting

## Projects

- [BOINC](https://boinc.berkeley.edu/): download the BOINC client
- [Rosetta@home](https://boinc.bakerlab.org/rosetta/): protein structure prediction for disease research
- [World Community Grid](https://www.worldcommunitygrid.org/): umbrella project for health and climate research

## Optional

- [More from thechelsuk](https://thechels.uk/projects): other projects by the same author
